theorems.name: Submission.deformation_ipl_cc_tendsto_setIntegral_of_partition
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (S : Set X) (E : ℕ → Set X) (f : ℕ → X → ℝ) (f₀ G : X → ℝ), (∀ i, NullMeasurableSet (E i) μ) → Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint E) → S =ᵐ[μ] (⋃ i, E i) → IntegrableOn G S μ → (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (f j) (μ.restrict S)) → AEStronglyMeasurable f₀ (μ.restrict S) → (∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict S), |f j x| ≤ G x) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict S), |f₀ x| ≤ G x) → (∀ i, Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in E i, f j x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in E i, f₀ x ∂μ))) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in S, f j x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in S, f₀ x ∂μ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
